hooks.command:
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) || { printf "%s
" "Xcode guard could not resolve the repository; refusing edit." >&2; exit 2; }; hook="$root/.codex/hooks/block-xcode-project-writes.py"; if [ ! -f "$hook" ]; then printf "%s
" "Xcode guard script is missing; refusing edit." >&2; exit 2; fi; python3 "$hook"; rc=$?; case "$rc" in 0|2) exit "$rc" ;; *) printf "%s
" "Xcode guard could not run; refusing edit." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
